rec.name: PDP Product Attributes (Customer Rating Sliders)

what.text: A PDP block named "CRO | Product Attributes". It shows a heading (e.g. "What our customers say") above a rounded, tinted card. The card holds several attribute rows, such as Look, Feeling, Vibe, or Quality, Wearing comfort & tolerance, and Size / Fit. Each row has a title and a horizontal slider-style bar with three labels beneath it (e.g. "not good / good / very good", "too small / fits perfectly / too big"). A dark marker on the bar shows the average customer rating for that attribute on that product. In the screenshots the block sits directly under the variant picker and price area, near the buy button. It also appears further down the page, near the store-benefits block.

why.text: It shows aggregated customer feedback on the product's qualities (quality, comfort, fit) at a glance. This is social proof, and it is more specific and quicker to scan than a star rating. The fit/size scale (too small / fits perfectly / too big) also answers common size and fit questions, which lowers purchase uncertainty and return risk. Placing it near the CTA brings reassurance to the moment of decision.

how.text: Add the "CRO | Product Attributes" block to the product template in the theme editor, beneath the variant picker or buy buttons. The block needs Shopify metaobjects and metafields set up first: attribute definitions (e.g. Look, Feeling, Vibe, with low/mid/high labels) and per-product values. Fill in the values on each product (demo content was added for the Goldie Hoop). The ticket links a setup video and an internal guide ("CRO | PDP | Product Attributes"), but their content is not available here. The store needed the Metaobject feature enabled in Custom data before setup could proceed.

items: CRO Heading: font size, font weight, font style (normal/italic)
CRO Title: font size, font weight, font style, position (left/center/right)
CRO Progress: background color of the bar

dependencies.text: Metaobject definitions and product metafields are required (the block's own note says: "requires Metaobjects and Metafields setup first"). The store must have Metaobjects available under Settings > Custom data; at Goldenstrawberry they were missing and had to be enabled. Needs a theme that supports the custom block (the Sectionfy/CRO theme library) and values entered per product.
